Problem Statement:
Given 2 numbers N and Q followed by N numbers. Now Q inputs of 2 numbers U and V are given. U indicates the starting index and V indicates the ending index. So for each U,V find the minimum of all values of the array from the index U to V (1 based indexing).
input_spec:
s of 2 numbers U and V are given. U indicates the starting index and V indicates the ending index. So for each U,V find the minimum of all values of the array from the index U to V (1 based indexing).

Input Description:
The input consists of two integers N and Q, followed by N numbers forming an array. Subsequently, Q pairs of integers U and V are given, where U is the starting index and V is the ending index (1-based indexing). N is up to 100000.
output_spec: For each query (U, V), the output should be the minimum value within the specified range [U, V] of the array.
